description: This file defines the FollowersController class which manages follow and unfollow actions for user profiles in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes route definitions, authorization, and uses MediatR to handle commands.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: Controller handling profile follow and unfollow HTTP requests, integrating MediatR for command dispatching.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to follow a profile by username, dispatching an Add.Command via MediatR.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE request to unfollow a profile by username, dispatching a Delete.Command via MediatR.
